data.description: Elegant 2-3 Bedroom Chalets in the Heart of Dubai Maritime City
data.long_description:
Ôrise is a remarkable architectural gem situated in the dynamic core of Dubai Maritime City. The development consists of two towers—one with 51 stories (G+4P+46) and the other with 32 stories (G+4P+27)—linked by a shared podium. The property offers an array of luxurious living spaces, including 1-3 bedroom apartments, 2-3 bedroom chalets, expansive 3-4 bedroom signature collections, and penthouses. The design is both sophisticated and striking, with residential units featuring a 10-degree tilt to maximize stunning, unobstructed views of the bustling city skyline and shimmering sea. Every home seamlessly blends modern design with ultimate comfort.

Residents of Ôrise enjoy an exceptional range of premium amenities, such as a fully-equipped gym, creative workspace, co-working areas, sauna and steam rooms, leisure and lap pools, Zen Garden, Vitality Centre, lush green spaces, an olive garden, and a kids' play area.

The development boasts a prime location, providing easy access to key landmarks: Dubai International Airport (14 minutes), Mina Rashid (2 minutes), Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa (12 minutes), DIFC (9 minutes), The Gold Souk (12 minutes), and Jumeirah Beach (7 minutes).

Ôrise is the perfect blend of architectural brilliance and comfort, offering a lifestyle of inspiration and opportunity at its very best.
